biography: Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra is an eminent Indian educational leader, social entrepreneur, and passionate Gandhian who hails from Gangoh in Saharanpur district, Western Uttar Pradesh. Over three-and-a-half decades, he has dedicated himself to empowering rural youth through education, skill development, and affordable healthcare. Beginning his journey as a full-time volunteer and promoter member with the NICE Society Trust in 1989, he co-founded Shobhit Deemed University in Meerut and Shobhit University in Gangoh, along with a 200-bed Ayurvedic research hospital and yoga-naturopathy center in rural Western UP. He serves as Chairman of the ASSOCHAM National Council on Education and Patron of CEGR, actively championing value-based learning, inclusive education, and nation-building.

quotes: Education must not merely prepare students for a living; it must prepare them for life, grounding them in ethics, compassion, and innovation.
True nation-building happens when world-class knowledge reaches the doorsteps of rural youth.
Ancient Indian wisdom and modern technology are not conflicting paths; they are two wings of the same bird of progress.
We need education that builds character, strengthens the mind, expands the intellect, and fosters self-reliance.
A teacher affects eternity; he can never tell where his influence stops.
Service to humanity with humility and truth is the highest form of worship.

milestones.title: Full-Time Volunteering & NICE Society Trust
milestones.summary: Began dedicated full-time volunteer work as a promoter member with the NICE Society Trust.
milestones.narrative: In 1989, Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra committed himself to societal transformation, joining as a promoter member of the National Institute of Computer Education (NICE) Society Trust. Anticipating the transformative impact of computing, he spearheaded computer literacy and vocational training across North India when technology was virtually inaccessible in rural pockets.

milestones.title: Establishment of Engineering & Tech Institutions
milestones.summary: Established Shobhit Institute of Engineering & Technology (SIET) in Meerut.
milestones.narrative: To bridge critical technological skill gaps in Uttar Pradesh, he spearheaded the founding of SIET Meerut, establishing state-of-the-art laboratories in computer science, biotechnology, and electronics, creating unprecedented research opportunities for rural and semi-urban learners.

milestones.title: Shobhit Deemed-to-be-University Charter
milestones.summary: Conferment of Deemed-to-be University status under Section 3 of UGC Act 1956.
milestones.narrative: In recognition of pioneering pedagogy and research in biotechnology and engineering, the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), Government of India, conferred Deemed University status to Shobhit Institute of Engineering & Technology, Meerut, fulfilling a landmark educational vision.

milestones.title: Shobhit University Gangoh State Charter
milestones.summary: Enactment of Shobhit University, Gangoh via Uttar Pradesh State Legislature.
milestones.narrative: Returning to his roots in Gangoh, Saharanpur, Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra founded Shobhit University Gangoh under Uttar Pradesh Act No. 3 of 2012, bringing higher education in agriculture, pharmacy, basic sciences, and engineering directly into a rural hinterland.

milestones.title: 200-Bed Ayurveda Hospital & Naturopathy Centre
milestones.summary: Inauguration of KSV Ayurved Medical College, 200-bed charitable hospital & Yoga-Naturopathy centre in rural Western UP.
milestones.narrative: Recognizing the dire need for affordable health infrastructure in rural Saharanpur, his trust established a 200-bed Ayurvedic hospital with advanced diagnostic facilities, maternal care units, and a dedicated Centre for Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences, offering subsidized and free treatments.

milestones.title: 15th World Education Summit (Mumbai)
milestones.summary: Delivered key addresses on higher education policy reform and future skills.
milestones.narrative: Addressed academic leaders, vice chancellors, and policymakers at the 15th World Education Summit in Mumbai, advocating for student-centric experiential learning and the democratization of skill education.

milestones.title: Gandhian Path for a Global Nonviolent Planet
milestones.summary: Featured speaker on peace, nonviolence, and Gandhian ideals at Gandhi Smriti, New Delhi.
milestones.narrative: On 9 December 2019, Kunwar Shekhar Vijendra spoke at Gandhi Smriti, New Delhi on 'A Gandhian Path for a Global Nonviolent Planet: Strategies of Action for a Culture of Peace,' emphasizing how educational institutions must cultivate active compassion and communal harmony.

milestones.title: Keynote on Rural Education & 13th ASSOCHAM Conclave
milestones.summary: Delivered keynote at 2nd National Education Excellence Conclave and ASSOCHAM 13th Higher Education Summit.
milestones.narrative: In late February 2020, as Chairman of ASSOCHAM National Council on Education, he addressed national leaders in New Delhi on rural education imperatives and inaugurated the 5th Global Outreach Conference on 'Modern Approaches for Smart Agriculture' at Shobhit University Meerut.
